# Transfer cell labels

Use the curated cell labels from Tung et al. as the reference and transfer the labels to another biological sample. The output is a per-cell CSV that can be supplied directly to `Intra-species-hourglass.Rmd`.

## Setup

```{r Library}
library(Seurat, quietly = TRUE)
library(magrittr, quietly = TRUE)
library(Matrix, quietly = TRUE)
library(ggplot2, quietly = TRUE)
library(pheatmap, quietly = TRUE)
```

Params

```{r Print markdown params}
params
```

Global variables

```{r Define global variables}
path_reference_mtx <- file.path(

  "outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5"
)
path_query_mtx <- file.path(
  params$path_10x_query,
  "outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5"
)
path_reference_cluster <- switch(
  params$reference_sample_id,
  "ptr_tenx_batch1" = file.path(
    params$path_10x_reference, 
    "outs/analysis/clustering/kmeans_10_clusters/clusters.csv"

  "egr_nextseq_batch1" = file.path(

  ),
  "lch_tenx_batch1" = file.path(
    "rawdata/Tung_Cluster/Lch_clusters.csv"
  ),
  "tar_nextseq_batch1" = file.path(
    "rawdata/Tung_Cluster/Tar_clusters_18.csv"
  )
) # remember to reformat Tar barcode by removing invalid "_" 
path_reference_umap <- switch (
  params$reference_sample_id,
  "ptr_tenx_batch1" = file.path(
    params$path_10x_reference, 
    "outs/analysis/umap/2_components/projection.csv"
  ),
  "egr_nextseq_batch1" = file.path(
    params$path_10x_reference, 
    "outs/analysis/umap/2_components/projection.csv"
  ),
  "lch_tenx_batch1" = "rawdata/Tung_Cluster/Lch_projection.csv",
  "tar_nextseq_batch1" = "rawdata/Tung_Cluster/Tar_projection.csv"
)

required_files <- c(
  path_reference_mtx,
  path_query_mtx,
  path_reference_cluster,
  params$reference_cluster_names
)

stopifnot(all(file.exists(required_files)))

cluster_levels <- c(
  "Fiber",
  "Vessel",
  "Fusiform Early Precursor",
  "Fusiform Organizer",
  "Ray Organizer",
  "Ray Precursor",
  "Fusiform Intermediate Precursor",
  "Ray",
  "Tracheid"
) # this is for fixing cluster levels on the plot

ordered_factor <- function(values) {
  factor(
    values,
    levels = c(
      intersect(cluster_levels, sort(unique(values))), 
      setdiff(sort(unique(values)), cluster_levels)
    )
  )
}

stopifnot(params$label_mode %in% c("cell", "cluster_majority"))
```

Helper functions

```{r Define helper functions}
preprocess_seurat <- function(
    seurat_obj,
    n_pcs,
    run_clustering = FALSE,
    resolution = 0.8
) {
  seurat_obj %<>% NormalizeData(verbose = FALSE)
  seurat_obj %<>% FindVariableFeatures(verbose = FALSE)
  seurat_obj %<>% ScaleData(
    features = VariableFeatures(.),
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  seurat_obj %<>% RunPCA(
    npcs = n_pcs,
    seed.use = 42,
    verbose = FALSE
  )

  if (run_clustering) {
    seurat_obj %<>% FindNeighbors(
      dims = seq_len(n_pcs),
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    seurat_obj %<>% FindClusters(
      resolution = resolution,
      random.seed = 42,
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    seurat_obj %<>% RunUMAP(
      dims = seq_len(n_pcs),
      seed.use = 42,
      verbose = FALSE
    )
  }

  seurat_obj
}

get_prediction_margin <- function(predictions) {
  score_columns <- grep(
    "^prediction\\.score\\.",
    colnames(predictions),
    value = TRUE
  )
  score_columns <- setdiff(
    score_columns,
    "prediction.score.max"
  )

  if (length(score_columns) < 2L) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, nrow(predictions)))
  }

  score_matrix <- as.matrix(
    predictions[, score_columns, drop = FALSE]
  )

  apply(
    score_matrix,
    1,
    function(x) {
      x <- sort(x, decreasing = TRUE)
      x[1] - x[2]
    }
  )
}
```

## Create the reference

```{r Create reference SeuratObject}
reference_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
  Read10X_h5(path_reference_mtx),
  project = params$reference_sample_id
)
reference_obj <- preprocess_seurat(
  reference_obj,
  n_pcs = as.integer(params$n_pcs),
  run_clustering = FALSE
)
reference_obj
```

Import the curated reference labels

```{r Import reference labels}
# cluster number-cell type mapping
reference_cluster_map <- read.csv(
  params$reference_cluster_names,
  check.names = FALSE
)
cluster_names <- reference_cluster_map$new
names(cluster_names) <- as.character(reference_cluster_map$old)

# barcode-cluster mapping
reference_cluster <- read.csv(
  path_reference_cluster,
  check.names = FALSE
)
reference_cluster %<>% dplyr::mutate(
  cell_label = cluster_names[as.character(Cluster)]
)
if (params$reference_sample_id == "tar_nextseq_batch1") {
  reference_cluster %<>% dplyr::mutate(
    Barcode = Barcode %>% sub("Kun", "Ta", .) %>% sub("_", "", .)
  )
}
rownames(reference_cluster) <- reference_cluster$Barcode

# put cell label to reference seurat object
reference_obj <- subset(reference_obj, cells = row.names(reference_cluster))
reference_obj[["cell_label"]] <- reference_cluster[Cells(reference_obj), "cell_label"] %>% as.character()
reference_obj$cell_label <- ordered_factor(reference_obj$cell_label)

if (anyNA(reference_obj$cell_label)) {
  stop(
    "At least one reference cell could not be assigned a curated cell label."
  )
}

Idents(reference_obj) <- "cell_label"
table(reference_obj$cell_label)
```

Quick check

```{r Quick check}
if (file.exists(path_reference_umap)) {
  emb <- read.csv(path_reference_umap)
  rownames(emb) <- emb$Barcode %>% 
    sub("Kun", "Ta", .) %>% 
    sub("_", "", .)
  emb <- emb[Cells(reference_obj), ]
  emb <- emb[, c("UMAP.1", "UMAP.2")] %>% as.matrix
  reference_obj[["umap"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(
    embeddings = emb, 
    key = "UMAP_", 
    global = TRUE, 
    assay = DefaultAssay(reference_obj)
  )
}

DimPlot(reference_obj) + 
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme_void()
```

## Exit if query is self

```{r Exit early if query is self}
if (params$query_sample_id == params$reference_sample_id) {
  cell_label_output <- data.frame(
    Barcode = as.character(reference_cluster$Barcode),
    cell_label = reference_cluster$cell_label,
    predicted_cell_label = reference_cluster$cell_label,
    cluster_majority_cell_label = reference_cluster$cell_label,
    seurat_cluster = as.character(reference_cluster$Cluster),
  
    # No prediction was performed for the curated reference.
    prediction_score_max = NA_real_,
    prediction_score_margin = NA_real_,
  
    # Curated labels are accepted directly.
    transfer_pass = TRUE,
    cluster_majority_fraction = 1,
  
    reference_sample_id = as.character(params$reference_sample_id),
    query_sample_id = as.character(params$query_sample_id),
    label_mode = "curated_reference",
  
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  dir.create(
    dirname(params$path_cell_label),
    showWarnings = FALSE,
    recursive = TRUE
  )
  write.csv(
    cell_label_output,
    file = params$path_cell_label,
    row.names = FALSE,
    quote = TRUE
  )
  head(cell_label_output)
  
  #
  message(
    "Query and reference are identical; wrote ",
    nrow(cell_label_output),
    " curated per-cell labels to ",
    params$path_cell_label,
    ". Skipping reference mapping."
  )

  # print sessionInfo and exit
  sessionInfo()
  knitr::knit_exit()
}
```


## Create the query

```{r Create query SeuratObject}
query_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
  Read10X_h5(path_query_mtx),
  project = params$query_sample_id
)
query_obj <- preprocess_seurat(
  query_obj,
  n_pcs = as.integer(params$n_pcs),
  run_clustering = TRUE,
  resolution = as.numeric(params$resolution)
)
query_obj
```

## Transfer cell labels

Reference anchors are identified in PCA space and the curated reference labels are transferred to individual query cells.

```{r Find transfer anchors}
n_pcs <- as.integer(params$n_pcs)
transfer_features <- intersect(
  VariableFeatures(reference_obj),
  rownames(query_obj)
)

if (length(transfer_features) < 50L) {
  stop("Too few shared variable features for reference mapping.")
}

anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(
  reference = reference_obj,
  query = query_obj,
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  reference.reduction = "pca",
  reduction = "pcaproject",
  features = transfer_features,
  dims = seq_len(n_pcs),
  verbose = TRUE
)
```

```{r Transfer labels}
predictions <- TransferData(
  anchorset = anchors,
  refdata = reference_obj$cell_label,
  dims = seq_len(n_pcs),
  verbose = TRUE
)

query_obj <- AddMetaData(
  query_obj,
  metadata = predictions
)

query_obj$prediction_score_margin <- get_prediction_margin(
  predictions
)

query_obj$transfer_pass <- (
  query_obj$prediction.score.max >=
    as.numeric(params$prediction_score_threshold)
) & (
  query_obj$prediction_score_margin >=
    as.numeric(params$prediction_margin_threshold)
)
```

Summarize labels within unsupervised query clusters

```{r Calculate cluster consensus}
query_metadata <- query_obj[[]] %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Barcode") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    predicted_cell_label = as.character(predicted.id),
    seurat_cluster = as.character(seurat_clusters)
  )

cluster_label_summary <- query_metadata %>%
  dplyr::count(
    seurat_cluster,
    predicted_cell_label,
    name = "n_cells"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(seurat_cluster) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cluster_total = sum(n_cells),
    cluster_fraction = n_cells / cluster_total
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    seurat_cluster,
    dplyr::desc(cluster_fraction),
    dplyr::desc(n_cells)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 1L) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    cluster_majority_cell_label = predicted_cell_label,
    cluster_majority_fraction = cluster_fraction
  )

query_metadata <- query_metadata %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    cluster_label_summary %>%
      dplyr::select(
        seurat_cluster,
        cluster_majority_cell_label,
        cluster_majority_fraction
      ),
    by = "seurat_cluster"
  )

selected_label <- if (params$label_mode == "cluster_majority") {
  query_metadata$cluster_majority_cell_label
} else {
  query_metadata$predicted_cell_label
}

query_metadata$cell_label <- ifelse(
  query_metadata$transfer_pass,
  selected_label,
  "Unassigned"
)

query_obj$predicted_cell_label <- query_metadata$predicted_cell_label[
  match(Cells(query_obj), query_metadata$Barcode)
]
query_obj$cluster_majority_cell_label <-
  query_metadata$cluster_majority_cell_label[
    match(Cells(query_obj), query_metadata$Barcode)
  ]
query_obj$cell_label <- factor(
  query_metadata$cell_label[
    match(Cells(query_obj), query_metadata$Barcode)
  ],
  levels = c(cluster_levels, "Unassigned")
)

cluster_label_summary
```

## Check transferred labels

```{r Plot transferred labels}
p_label <- DimPlot(
  query_obj,
  group.by = "cell_label",
  reduction = "umap"
) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme_void() +
  labs(
    title = params$query_sample_id,
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Transferred labels; mode = %s",
      params$label_mode
    )
  )

p_score <- FeaturePlot(
  query_obj,
  features = "prediction.score.max",
  reduction = "umap"
) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(direction = -1) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(title = "Maximum transfer score")

p_label | p_score
```

```{r Plot query cluster-label composition}
cluster_label_table <- table(
  cluster = query_obj$seurat_clusters,
  cell_label = query_obj$cell_label
)

cluster_label_prop <- cluster_label_table /
  rowSums(cluster_label_table)

pheatmap::pheatmap(
  cluster_label_prop,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  display_numbers = TRUE,
  number_format = "%.2f",
  border_color = NA,
  main = paste0(
    params$query_sample_id,
    "\nTransferred cell-label proportions by query cluster"
  )
)
```

```{r Summarize transfer confidence}
transfer_summary <- query_metadata %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_cells = dplyr::n(),
    n_pass = sum(transfer_pass),
    fraction_pass = mean(transfer_pass),
    median_score = median(prediction.score.max),
    median_margin = median(prediction_score_margin)
  )

label_summary <- query_metadata %>%
  dplyr::count(
    cell_label,
    transfer_pass,
    name = "n_cells"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cell_label) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    fraction = n_cells / sum(n_cells)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

transfer_summary
label_summary
```

## Write cell-label CSV

The `cell_label` column is the analysis label. Cells below either confidence threshold are marked `Unassigned`; the unfiltered prediction is retained in `predicted_cell_label`.

```{r Write cell label CSV}
cell_label_output <- query_metadata %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Barcode,
    cell_label,
    predicted_cell_label,
    cluster_majority_cell_label,
    seurat_cluster,
    prediction_score_max = prediction.score.max,
    prediction_score_margin,
    transfer_pass,
    cluster_majority_fraction,
    reference_sample_id = params$reference_sample_id,
    query_sample_id = params$query_sample_id,
    label_mode = params$label_mode
  )

dir.create(
  dirname(params$path_cell_label),
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

write.csv(
  cell_label_output,
  file = params$path_cell_label,
  row.names = FALSE,
  quote = TRUE
)

head(cell_label_output)
```
